title: Igeragezwa ry'Inyota
intro: Umuryango wari ufite icyifuzo cyo kubona ubuyobozi bwo kurengera intego yabo, wasabye ko hashyirwaho umuyobozi ubayobora. Ubwo icyifuzo cyabo cyasubizwaga, uwatoranyijwe yahuye n'amakenga, kuko uwo muntu atari afite icyubahiro nk'icyo yari yiteze ku isi. Mbere y'uko habaho imirwano ikomeye, uyu muyobozi mushya yageragezaga disipuline y'ingabo akoresheje igeragezwa ryoroshye ariko rikomeye ry'ubwitonzi.
clues: Nagizwe umuyobozi w’ingabo nyuma y’uko abaturage banjye basabye umuyobozi wo kurwanira mu nzira ya Allah.
Benshi mu bantu banjye babanje gushidikanya ku ishyirwaho ryanjye, bavuga ko nta bukire nari mfite kandi ko ntari mfite mu muryango w’icyubahiro.
Natowe kuko Allah yari yarampaye ubumenyi bwinshi n'uburebure bukomeye bw'umubiri.
Ikimenyetso cy'uko Imana yanshinze umurimo ni ukugaruka kw'Isanduku y'Isezerano, itwarwa n'abamarayika, byazanye amahoro mu mitima y'abizera.
Ubwo nagendaga n'abasirikare banjye, natangaje ko tuzageragerezwa ku ruzi.
Nategetse ingabo zanjye ko umuntu wese unywa amazi menshi mu ruzi atari uwanjye, mu gihe uzafata ikiyiko kimwe gusa mu ntoki ze azasigara.

trial.label: Ni ikihe kibazo cy'ingenzi nagerageje?
options: Kubaka uruzitiro rwo kurwanya Gogi na Magogi

location.label: Ni ikihe cyari ikimenyetso cy'ingenzi cy'ububasha bwanjye?
options: Ikoti ry'icyuma rikozwe mu cyuma cyoroshye

outcome.label: Ingaruka z'ubukangurambaga bwanjye zari izihe?
options: Gutandukanya inyanja itukura kugira ngo uhunge umunyagitugu
Gushinga ingoma irambye mu izina ryanjye

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
